section: A. Aerosol, Gas, and Chemistry Measurements
measurement: Aerosol number, size, CCN, and trace gases composition, optical properties

section: A. Aerosol, Gas, and Chemistry Measurements
measurement: Ultrafine condensation particle counter (3–3,000 nm; cut size 3–3.5 nm)

section: A. Aerosol, Gas, and Chemistry Measurements
measurement: Aerosol number size distributions from ultrafine to coarse modes
science_leverage: Defines aerosol size distributions from ultrafine to coarse modes governing CCN activation, aerosol growth, dust contributions, and aerosol removal by convection.

section: A. Aerosol, Gas, and Chemistry Measurements
measurement: CCN concentrations

section: A. Aerosol, Gas, and Chemistry Measurements
measurement: Aerosol scattering and absorption coefficients

section: A. Aerosol, Gas, and Chemistry Measurements
measurement: Size-segregated aerosol mass and chemical composition
science_leverage: Size-segregated aerosol composition for distinguishing agricultural dust, pollen, biological aerosol particles, smoke, and transported anthropogenic aerosol contributions.

section: A. Aerosol, Gas, and Chemistry Measurements
measurement: Carbon monoxide mixing ratio

section: A. Aerosol, Gas, and Chemistry Measurements
measurement: Ozone mixing ratio and photochemical tracer
